emberbrand.name: Emberbrand
emberbrand.desc: Sheathed in a low, constant heat.

tidecleaver.name: Tidecleaver
tidecleaver.desc: Salt never dries on the blade.

aetherglass.name: Aetherglass
aetherglass.desc: Cut from a sleeping Engine. It hums.

emberbrand_lesser.name: Ember Brand
emberbrand_lesser.desc: A brand with a coal still in the pommel.

rimebrand.name: Rime Brand
rimebrand.desc: The blade sweats in warm weather.

stormbrand.name: Storm Brand
stormbrand.desc: It clicks when the air is dry.

tidebrand.name: Tide Brand
tidebrand.desc: Salt dries on it overnight, wherever it has been.

galebrand.name: Gale Brand
galebrand.desc: Lighter than it looks, and it hums on the downswing.

vigilbrand.name: Vigil Brand
vigilbrand.desc: Lantern-blessed, which the Ninth would say means very little.

ashbrand.name: Ash Brand
ashbrand.desc: It does not take a shine, and never has.

stonebrand.name: Stone Brand
stonebrand.desc: Heavy at the tip. It wants to go downward.

emberedge.name: Ember Edge
emberedge.desc: The fuller glows when it is drawn quickly.

rimeedge.name: Rime Edge
rimeedge.desc: It rings a half-tone flat in the cold.

galeedge.name: Gale Edge
galeedge.desc: The parry is faster than the swing.

vigiledge.name: Vigil Edge
vigiledge.desc: Nine bands at the ricasso, one worn smooth.

ashedge.name: Ash Edge
ashedge.desc: Nothing reflects in it, including the room.

stoneedge.name: Stone Edge
stoneedge.desc: Forged around a core of something older.

emberwraps.name: Ember Wraps
emberwraps.desc: Wound over a banked coal. Rewrapped daily.

ashclaws.name: Ash Claws
ashclaws.desc: Cut from something that did not want to be cut from.

quietedge.name: Quiet Edge
quietedge.desc: The blade that ended the Ninth Lantern.

ashenkatana.name: Ashen Katana
ashenkatana.desc: Folded four hundred times at Ashenhall.

longspear.name: Long Spear
longspear.desc: Strikes from the back row unpenalised.

lanternstaff.name: Lantern Staff
lanternstaff.desc: Its flame has never once gone out.

quillbrush.name: Quill Brush
quillbrush.desc: Paints what it is told, mostly.

silkrobe.name: Silk Robe
silkrobe.desc: Woven for those who fight with words.

aetherweave.name: Aetherweave
aetherweave.desc: The threads are not entirely thread.

wardenmail.name: Warden Mail
wardenmail.desc: Worn by those who held the last gate.

twinfang.name: Twin Fang
twinfang.desc: Wield a weapon in each hand.

earnestcharm.name: Earnest Charm
earnestcharm.desc: Cast two spells in one turn.

quietstep.name: Quiet Step
quietstep.desc: Wild things lose interest in you.

siltroadpass.name: Silt Road Pass
siltroadpass.desc: Lets you through the Ferran checkpoint.

steadyingdram.name: Steadying Dram
steadyingdram.desc: Steadies a fit or a temper.

hawksbreath.name: Hawk's Breath
hawksbreath.desc: Sharpens the eye. Critical hits come easier.

pyreflask.name: Pyre Flask
pyreflask.desc: Heavy fire damage to all foes.

rimeflask.name: Rime Flask
rimeflask.desc: Heavy ice damage to all foes.

arcflask.name: Arc Flask
arcflask.desc: Heavy lightning damage to all foes.

galeflask.name: Gale Flask
galeflask.desc: Heavy wind damage to all foes.

lanternoil.name: Lantern Oil
lanternoil.desc: Holy damage to all foes. Burns the buried.

siltroadsabre.name: Silt Road Sabre
siltroadsabre.desc: Plain, straight, and sharpened every night.

wardensfalchion.name: Warden's Falchion
wardensfalchion.desc: Issued to the gate watch. Rarely returned.

bellringer.name: Bellringer
bellringer.desc: Rings once on the blow, then falls quiet.

saltbitten.name: Saltbitten Blade
saltbitten.desc: Pitted by the Drowned Coast, and keener for it.

cinderbrand.name: Cinderbrand
cinderbrand.desc: What Emberbrand grows into, given a hotter forge.

brokenstandard.name: The Broken Standard
brokenstandard.desc: Half a sword. It has never needed the other half.

vigilblade.name: Vigil Blade
vigilblade.desc: Kept by the door of a lantern that still burns.

enginecut.name: Enginecut
enginecut.desc: Struck from the same sleeping metal as Aetherglass.

sundersong.name: Sundersong
sundersong.desc: The last thing the Engine made. It made it quietly.

gullkinfang.name: Gullkin Fang
gullkinfang.desc: Taken from a raider who had stopped needing it.

nightknife.name: Night Market Knife
nightknife.desc: Sold quietly, and never with a receipt.

salvagersdirk.name: Salvager's Dirk
salvagersdirk.desc: Prises open more doors than it opens throats.

serpentstooth.name: Serpent's Tooth
serpentstooth.desc: Envenomed once, a century ago. Still is.

widowsknife.name: Widow's Knife
widowsknife.desc: Harrowmere keeps three of these and admits to none.

reliquaryknife.name: Reliquary Knife
reliquaryknife.desc: Every relic hunter has heard of it. One has held it.

thirdfold.name: The Third Fold
thirdfold.desc: A practice blade, if you were raised at Ashenhall.

temperedash.name: Tempered Ash
temperedash.desc: Quenched in the ash of the hall that made it.

winterlong.name: Winter Long
winterlong.desc: Drawn slowly. It is colder than the air around it.

mourningsteel.name: Mourning Steel
mourningsteel.desc: Forged for a funeral that was never held.

thelastfold.name: The Last Fold
thelastfold.desc: Four hundred folds, and then one more.

ferranpike.name: Ferran Pike
ferranpike.desc: Checkpoint issue. Strikes from the back row unpenalised.

boarspear.name: Boar Spear
boarspear.desc: The crossbar is there to stop what you stabbed.

tidewardlance.name: Tideward Lance
tidewardlance.desc: Coast watch work. Never rusts, never dries.

stormpike.name: Stormpike
stormpike.desc: Held upright in a storm, on purpose.

wellspringlance.name: Wellspring Lance
wellspringlance.desc: The Ninth Well gave it up without argument.

handcrossbow.name: Hand Crossbow
handcrossbow.desc: Slow to load, but it does not care where you stand.

latchbow.name: Latch Bow
latchbow.desc: A goat-foot lever, and half the winding.

windlassbow.name: Windlass Bow
windlassbow.desc: Cranked, not drawn. Punches through plate.

quarrelengine.name: Quarrel Engine
quarrelengine.desc: Feeds itself. The engineers are proud of that.

siegelock.name: Siege Lock
siegelock.desc: Marchetti Works, and they are still not certain how.

bandedgrips.name: Banded Grips
bandedgrips.desc: Iron bands over old leather. Honest enough.

stillwaterwraps.name: Still Water Wraps
stillwaterwraps.desc: Bound the way the Grandmaster binds them.

cairnbreakers.name: Cairn Breakers
cairnbreakers.desc: Made for stone. They work on other things.

mountainhands.name: Mountain Hands
mountainhands.desc: Weighted at the knuckle. The ground helps.

kilnwraps.name: Kiln Wraps
kilnwraps.desc: Cinderspine cloth. It keeps the heat it was given.

boneclaws.name: Bone Claws
boneclaws.desc: Bound to the knuckle with wet cord. It dried tight.

bramblehooks.name: Bramble Hooks
bramblehooks.desc: Thorn-shaped, and they came off something that grew them.

roadwolfclaws.name: Roadwolf Claws
roadwolfclaws.desc: She named the wolf first. Then she wore it.

frostmaulclaws.name: Frostmaul Claws
frostmaulclaws.desc: They frost over between one swipe and the next.

greenmotherclaws.name: Greenmother's Claws
greenmotherclaws.desc: The wood grew them for her. She says it asked first.

throwingirons.name: Throwing Irons
throwingirons.desc: Weighted flat. They come back if you are lucky.

vagrantdice.name: Vagrant Dice
vagrantdice.desc: They land the way he needs them to. Usually.

vellumdarts.name: Vellum Darts
vellumdarts.desc: Archive tags, sharpened. The Archivist disapproves.

saltchakram.name: Salt Chakram
saltchakram.desc: Coast work. The edge is crusted and all the better.

thevagrantstar.name: The Vagrant Star
thevagrantstar.desc: He wagered the house on it once. He won.

siltglassrod.name: Siltglass Rod
siltglassrod.desc: Cloudy glass, drawn from river silt. It carries well.

chorusrod.name: Chorus Rod
chorusrod.desc: Struck once, it answers itself for a while.

stillglass.name: Stillglass Rod
stillglass.desc: No bubble in it anywhere. Nobody knows how.

resonancerod.name: Resonance Rod
resonancerod.desc: It is already humming when you pick it up.

pilgrimstaff.name: Pilgrim's Staff
pilgrimstaff.desc: Worn smooth at the grip by a long walk.

ninthlanternstaff.name: Ninth Lantern Staff
ninthlanternstaff.desc: Its flame went out years ago. It works anyway.

vesperstaff.name: Vesper Staff
vesperstaff.desc: For the last office of the day, and the last of all.

inkstonebrush.name: Inkstone Brush
inkstonebrush.desc: Grinds its own ink. Paints closer to the truth.

longlookbrush.name: Long Look Brush
longlookbrush.desc: Look long enough at a thing and it holds still.

thelastportrait.name: The Last Portrait
thelastportrait.desc: The sitter never came back for it.

roadcoat.name: Road Coat
roadcoat.desc: Oiled twice a year, whether it needs it or not.

brigandine.name: Brigandine
brigandine.desc: Plates riveted inside the cloth, where they show as studs.

saltleathers.name: Salt Leathers
saltleathers.desc: Cured in the shallows. The sea has stopped minding it.

raidersjack.name: Raider's Jack
raidersjack.desc: Cut short so it does not catch when you run.

bramblecoat.name: Bramble Coat
bramblecoat.desc: Thorn-woven. Nothing it lets through is poisonous.

stillwatergi.name: Still Water Gi
stillwatergi.desc: Unarmoured, and yet somehow the hardest to hit.

ferranplate.name: Ferran Plate
ferranplate.desc: Stamped, not fitted. Everyone wears the same one.

ashencuirass.name: Ashenhall Cuirass
ashencuirass.desc: Lacquered black. The hall burned; this did not.

enginemail.name: Engine Mail
enginemail.desc: It is warm even in the cold, and nobody likes that.

siegeplate.name: Siege Plate
siegeplate.desc: Made for standing in a gap for a very long time.

wyrmscaleplate.name: Wyrmscale Plate
wyrmscaleplate.desc: Drinks fire. Feels winter twice as keenly.

deepwardplate.name: Deepward Plate
deepwardplate.desc: Worn down the well, by someone who came back up.

wayfarerrobe.name: Wayfarer's Robe
wayfarerrobe.desc: Roomy, patched, and pocketed all the way down.

chanterrobe.name: Chanter's Robe
chanterrobe.desc: Cut so the sleeves move when the voice does.

vellumvestments.name: Vellum Vestments
vellumvestments.desc: Archive dress. The margins are annotated.

vigilrobe.name: Vigil Robe
vigilrobe.desc: Whoever wears it can always be heard.

deepwellrobe.name: Deepwell Robe
deepwellrobe.desc: Damp at the hem, always, whatever the weather.

mantleofnine.name: Mantle of Nine
mantleofnine.desc: Nine layers, and the ninth is not cloth.

feltedhood.name: Felted Hood
feltedhood.desc: Warm, shapeless, and beloved by whoever owns it.

wayfarerhat.name: Wayfarer's Hat
wayfarerhat.desc: Broad enough to keep rain off the collar.

cutpursecowl.name: Cutpurse Cowl
cutpursecowl.desc: Nobody ever remembers the face under it.

archivistcap.name: Archivist's Cap
archivistcap.desc: Flat, plain, and worn with enormous seriousness.

greenhood.name: Greenmother's Hood
greenhood.desc: Leaf-sewn. The wood will not let you drowse in it.

chanterscirclet.name: Chanter's Circlet
chanterscirclet.desc: Thin silver, and it rings faintly when spells land.

longlookveil.name: Long Look Veil
longlookveil.desc: You see less through it and understand more.

sallet.name: Sallet
sallet.desc: A long tail at the back, to keep a blade off the neck.

visoredhelm.name: Visored Helm
visoredhelm.desc: The slit is narrow on purpose. Nothing gets in the eye.

ferranhelm.name: Ferran Helm
ferranhelm.desc: Lined with the same wire as the outpost lamps.

gravehelm.name: Grave Helm
gravehelm.desc: Taken off a cairn. Politely, and with an apology.

enginecrown.name: Engine Crown
enginecrown.desc: A circlet of cold brass. It thinks along with you.

wardenshelm.name: Warden's Helm
wardenshelm.desc: The pair to the mail, and just as rarely given up.

ninthcrown.name: The Ninth Crown
ninthcrown.desc: Nine bands of salt-iron. It has outlasted nine heads.

ironbuckler.name: Iron Buckler
ironbuckler.desc: Small, quick, and meant for turning a blade aside.

kiteshield.name: Kite Shield
kiteshield.desc: Covers the leg as well, which the militia insisted on.

ferranbulwark.name: Ferran Bulwark
ferranbulwark.desc: Braced to be planted. It does not like being carried.

tidewardshield.name: Tideward Shield
tidewardshield.desc: The sea runs off it and takes the heat with it.

vigilshield.name: Vigil Shield
vigilshield.desc: Lantern-marked. Held all night without lowering.

ashenaegis.name: Ashen Aegis
ashenaegis.desc: Scorched down one side and stronger for it.

enginewardshield.name: Engine Ward
enginewardshield.desc: A lattice, not a plate. It disagrees with lightning.

reliquaryshield.name: Reliquary Shield
reliquaryshield.desc: Nailed with a hundred small saints. None of them budge.

theninthgate.name: The Ninth Gate
theninthgate.desc: The gate they held. Someone cut a shield out of it.

cinderheart.name: Cinder Heart
cinderheart.desc: Drinks fire. You will feel the cold twice over.

winterheart.name: Winter Heart
winterheart.desc: Drinks ice. Fire finds you very easily.

stormheart.name: Storm Heart
stormheart.desc: Drinks lightning. Keep out of the water.

gravebindings.name: Grave Bindings
gravebindings.desc: Drinks the dark. Holy light is unkind in return.

lanternheart.name: Lantern Heart
lanternheart.desc: Drinks holy light. The dark comes looking.

ninefoldcharm.name: Ninefold Charm
ninefoldcharm.desc: Halves all six common elements. No weakness bought.

quicklimecharm.name: Quicklime Charm
quicklimecharm.desc: You will not be turned to stone while you hold it.

clearwatercharm.name: Clearwater Charm
clearwatercharm.desc: Wards poison, venom, seizure and blindness.

steadyband.name: Steady Band
steadyband.desc: You will keep your own mind, and your own side.

wakefulcharm.name: Wakeful Charm
wakefulcharm.desc: Nothing will hold your turn away from you.

unbrokenoath.name: Unbroken Oath
unbrokenoath.desc: Death may be dealt to you but not promised.

ninthward.name: The Ninth Ward
ninthward.desc: Every ailment there is, and it wards all of them.

deepwellpendant.name: Deepwell Pendant
deepwellpendant.desc: Cold against the breastbone. Deepens the well.

resonantcharm.name: Resonant Charm
resonantcharm.desc: Spells cost half as much to those who listen.

engineheart.name: Engine Heart
engineheart.desc: Every spell costs one point. The Engine pays the rest.

magpiechain.name: Magpie Chain
magpiechain.desc: Doubles the chance to pilfer, and keeps you quick.

wanderersbell.name: Wanderer's Bell
wanderersbell.desc: Rings too softly to hear. Wild things leave anyway.

pilgrimsknot.name: Pilgrim's Knot
pilgrimsknot.desc: Tied at the start of a long road, untied at the end.

keeneyecharm.name: Keen Eye Charm
keeneyecharm.desc: Luck +20, and a little harder to hit.

wardensignet.name: Warden's Signet
wardensignet.desc: Armour where a ring has no business being.

oathstone.name: Oathstone
oathstone.desc: Heavy in the hand, and steadying with it.

vagrantcharm.name: Vagrant Charm
vagrantcharm.desc: Luck +30. He would not sell it, so someone copied it.

stillwaterdram.name: Still Water Dram
stillwaterdram.desc: Guards body, mind and blood at once.

overwinddraught.name: Overwind Draught
overwinddraught.desc: Hastes and sharpens the whole party.

quenchcharge.name: Quench Charge
quenchcharge.desc: Ruinous damage to all foes. Nothing drinks it.

oathcut.name: Oathcut
oathcut.desc: No element, no temper, no argument. It simply cuts.

quenchbrand.name: Quenchbrand
quenchbrand.desc: Drawn out of the pit still orange. It never went cold.

gainsayknife.name: Gainsay Knife
gainsayknife.desc: Argues with a pocket and generally wins.

broodfang.name: Brood Fang
broodfang.desc: Pulled from an acre widow. It is still wet.

harrowfold.name: The Harrow Fold
harrowfold.desc: Folded over a field instead of a forge. It took.

stillfold.name: The Still Fold
stillfold.desc: Cold enough that the scabbard sweats in summer.

overwindlance.name: Overwind Lance
overwindlance.desc: Light in the hand and quick out of it. Reaches from the back row.

quenchlance.name: Quench Lance
quenchlance.desc: Tempered in the slaking pit and never quite dried.

ironhail.name: Ironhail
ironhail.desc: Six bolts in the box and a crank that never jams.

bloodingwraps.name: Blooding Wraps
bloodingwraps.desc: Bound in the yards, by someone who had stopped counting.

quenchgauntlets.name: Quench Gauntlets
quenchgauntlets.desc: The knuckles arc when you make a fist. They cannot help it.

broodclaws.name: Brood Claws
broodclaws.desc: Eight of them came off one thing. She kept the best four.

witheringclaws.name: Withering Claws
witheringclaws.desc: What they open does not close. The Kindly Ground drinks it.

wagerstones.name: Wager Stones
wagerstones.desc: Nine of them, and he will tell you which is which.

overwindchakram.name: Overwind Chakram
overwindchakram.desc: It comes back before you have finished throwing it.

hollowglass.name: Hollowglass Rod
hollowglass.desc: Blown around nothing at all, very carefully.

overwindrod.name: Overwind Rod
overwindrod.desc: The spell is out before the word is finished.

kindlystaff.name: The Kindly Staff
kindlystaff.desc: Carried at the head of a great many small funerals.

thelongargument.name: The Long Argument
thelongargument.desc: Two hundred pages of it, and she has read them all.

broodleathers.name: Brood Leathers
broodleathers.desc: Chitin, boiled and lapped. Nothing it lets through festers.

overwindcoat.name: Overwind Coat
overwindcoat.desc: Cut so short it barely is one. You will not be caught in it.

bloodingplate.name: Blooding Plate
bloodingplate.desc: Worn by a man who could not be goaded, and was, once.

quenchmail.name: Quench Mail
quenchmail.desc: Taken in and out of the pit until it stopped minding either.

answeringrobe.name: Answering Robe
answeringrobe.desc: Whatever is said to it, it has already said back.

kindlyvestment.name: Kindly Vestment
kindlyvestment.desc: The ground cannot tell you are alive. This tells it.

broodveil.name: Brood Veil
broodveil.desc: Fine mesh, doubled. Nothing lands on you and nothing lands in your eye.

overwindcowl.name: Overwind Cowl
overwindcowl.desc: Weighted at the hem so it does not go over your eyes.

bloodinghelm.name: Blooding Helm
bloodinghelm.desc: Blinkered like a plough horse, and for the same reason.

quenchcrown.name: Quench Crown
quenchcrown.desc: A band of three metals that disagree about temperature.

answeringshield.name: Answering Shield
answeringshield.desc: Everything said to it comes back the way it came.

quenchward.name: Quench Ward
quenchward.desc: Drinks the sea. Do not hold it up in a storm.

bothhands.name: Both Hands
bothhands.desc: A weapon in each. The second swing lands softer.

echostone.name: Echo Stone
echostone.desc: Says everything twice, and means it both times.

ledgerofsmalldebts.name: Ledger of Small Debts
ledgerofsmalldebts.desc: Every blow is entered against them, and collected.

answeringmirror.name: Answering Mirror
answeringmirror.desc: You stand in a Reflect you did not cast, all fight, always.

tideheart.name: Tide Heart
tideheart.desc: Drinks the sea. Lightning goes looking for you in it.

stoneheart.name: Stone Heart
stoneheart.desc: Drinks the ground. The open air is unkind after that.

wellheart.name: Well Heart
wellheart.desc: Drinks what the Well gives off. Lantern light burns twice.

gravewardknot.name: Graveward Knot
gravewardknot.desc: Death may still be dealt to you. It may not be declared.

overwindband.name: Overwind Band
overwindband.desc: Speed +34. Wound past the stop, and left there.
